title: Find, share and enjoy better coffee
description: Coffee Rambler is a free resource for discovering more about all things specialty coffee, with home brew guides, coffee archive and coffee around the world. Login and share your experiences with our growing community.
body:
# Welcome to Coffee Rambler ​ Helping each other to find, make and enjoy better Coffee

## [Blog Archive](/archive)

Explore the world of specialty coffee with Coffee Rambler's blog posts. Categories include sensory training, basic brewing information, coffee recipes, city guides and more.

[![Coffee Rambler blog ](/images/675337_942531fd7b744f1a961704d870be1f0a~mv2.jpg)](/archive)

[![Brewing guides](/images/675337_066f59671f3b4a92b61cb21d62577c8b~mv2.jpg)](/brewing-guides)

## [Home Brewing Guides](/brewing-guides)

Make coffee like a barista with Coffee Rambler's brewing guides.

## Coffee Rambler AI

Coffee Rambler AI is the coffee app that gets smarter the more you brew.

[Sign up](http://www.rambler.coffee/signup) for free online. 

​

​

- Download to your mobile's homepage to use as an app​

- Log your brews, beans and equipment and get personalised stats on your preferences​

- Get expert advice from the chat function, which remembers you and analyses your brew setup​

- Complete the origin map by adding more brews​

- Enhance your sensory skills and build your own flavour wheel

​

Go to [Rambler.coffee](http://www.rambler.coffee)to try it today

​

Read more about the Enthusiast tier [in the archive](/post/coffee-rambler-ai-what-the-coffee-enthusiast-tier-actually-does)[.](/post/coffee-rambler-ai-what-the-coffee-enthusiast-tier-actually-does)

[![The flavour wheel available on coffee rambler ai. sensory palate](/images/675337_635b291743a84837a77127fe674c2dbb~mv2.png)](http://www.rambler.coffee)

![World Coffee Map](/images/675337_87f13b2039374f44a74f6156d7141986~mv2.jpg)
